description_en: The apartment is located on the eighth residential floor of one of the newest and quality complexes in the Porcelani area, on Xhanfize Keko Street. The complex is expected to be completed by the middle of 2026. The complex will offer all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life such as: pharmacy, bakery, restaurant, bar, supermarket, gym, luxury swimming pool, playground for children, etc. It has a total area of ​​105.66 M2 and a net area of ​​88.11 M2. It is organized in: A living room together with a kitchen, two bedrooms, a toilet, a balcony. The rapid development of the area makes this complex a very good investment opportunity for rent or resale, in addition to housing. For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
